'''Brian Berryhill''' played the [[September 1999 Anderson tournament]] in Anderson, Indiana, and finished 2–4. [[Steven Horton]] beat him in the first game, writing that Berryhill usually started Ice Plains with Defensive Perimeter and Combat Readiness.<ref name="cec-r2">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report2.html Anderson, In (9/25/99)], Steven Horton, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030128/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report2.html Internet Archive]</ref>
